subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue remain the combined tracker for embedded-runner import coupling plus Discord monitor boundary cleanup, or should the remaining work be split between https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 and a separate Discord monitor issue?
rationale: The remaining work spans two hot ownership boundaries and only the embedded-runner portion is clearly covered by the RuntimePlan RFC, so automation should not choose the long-term tracker split or sequencing.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-visible staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling while smaller PRs land independently.

options.title: Split Remaining Scope
options.body: Move embedded-runner cleanup under the RuntimePlan RFC and create or identify a separate Discord monitor boundary issue before closing this combined tracker.

options.title: Defer Until RuntimePlan Settles
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked on RuntimePlan finalization, then reassess whether the Discord monitor still needs its own tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-visible staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling while smaller PRs land independently.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the live keep-open review and has the strongest cross-surface routing signal for this tracker decision.
